equivalent_formulations: Tail-tightness formulation: identify a nonnegative source-derived annular functional T_k(R) for which lim_{R→∞} limsup_{k→∞} T_k(R)=0, with exact normalization and pressure contribution specified.

Signed-flux formulation: if absolute annular tightness is unavailable, identify an exact signed local-energy flux identity whose boundary terms cancel/telescope in a source-justified large-radius limit.

Concentration-compactness formulation: fixed-radius local convergence controls the compact core but does not by itself exclude mass/energy transport to moving centers or infinity; a tightness/recentering/minimality witness is needed.
Rigidity-interface formulation: an Euler Liouville theorem is admissible only after every additional global hypothesis is shown to be inherited by the exact ancient limit.

Concentration-compactness in critical PDE separates local compactness from global compactness by explicit tightness/modulo-symmetry controls; this is a structural analogy only.
